effect: 130-degree lightning cleave, 4.2m, 1.8A. Open for 4s gives +25% basic damage.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: Green blade aura for 6s: +45% basic damage and +30% attack speed. Guard one frontal blow by 65% for 2s, earning Answer for 5s.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: Collision-respecting 5m dash over .16s; 4s of +80% movement speed. Leaves a 1.5s slowing wake.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: 4m, 360-degree moving field. .9A opening hit, plus four .55A pulses over .8s; slows by 35%. Open adds .4A and is consumed; Answer adds 1.2m push on opening hit.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: 3.8m fire field for 4s. .5A every .5s, 25% enemy slow, 25% damage reduction for caster inside. One field per caster.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: 110-degree radiant cleave, 4.5m, 3A, 1m push, .35A healing on a real hit. Answer adds .5A damage and .6A healing.
presentation: Existing runtime reference

effect: Collision-bound advance; redraw front at destination
presentation: Low red edge ahead of boots. Push through a thin PvE rank; opponents sidestep the telegraphed lane. Repositions ground for Bannerless and Crosscut.

effect: Crossing your front during windup widens arc to 180, not damage
presentation: Two intersecting slashes. Rewards moving through packs; avoid front side to deny widening. Basics supply the line, no extra resource.

timing_scaling: .2 cast; 16s CD; scales shield with HP
effect: 3s modest shield; front expires when shield breaks
presentation: Small clothless stake flash. Stabilizes a dangerous advance; concentrated damage breaks the foothold. Competes with retreating through Rearward.

skill: Rearward Cut - trade front for escape
effect: Retreat along ground; erase front, briefly slow crossed enemies
presentation: Blade dragged behind, no hidden i-frames. Withdraw from surround; pursue around the cut. Pays earned geography rather than stamina.

effect: Crossing deals damage and short slow; 4s duration
presentation: Upright low red stakes. Packs can be lured across; PvP can wait out or go around. Consumes front so it cannot also power Bannerless.

effect: If both stand beyond front, relocate line behind target; no CC
presentation: Raised blade and decisive downward step. Strong against a committed single target, avoidable by retreat. Reestablishes geography after Roadbreak without becoming a free gap closer.

skill: Tie the Near - place deliberate anchor
effect: Mark 6s; replaces oldest of two anchors
presentation: Visible wrist-to-target thread. Starts setup without waiting for basics; break LOS to deny. Enables other five without making it compulsory every cycle.

effect: Faster partner is slowed 30% for 3s while close to other
presentation: Heavy bead on link. Tames mixed PvE packs; separate to break. Combines with Loom Gate but offers no hard root.

effect: No extra recursive procs
presentation: Quick diagonal thread flash. Choose pair to pressure two enemies; partner can step behind cover. Never chains beyond two or replaces basic DPS.

effect: Consume its knot to remove one removable self debuff
presentation: Thread reels back visibly. Emergency PvE cleansing; in PvP denies setup pressure but sacrifices link. Not a universal invulnerability cleanse.

skill: Loom Gate - make the link a boundary
timing_scaling: .65 cast; 18s CD; .5A per crossing, once per foe
effect: 3s visible trip line, brief slow
presentation: Low violet thread fence. Controls a pack's approach; jump is not assumed, walk around endpoints. Strong placement, not automatic homing CC.

timing_scaling: .7 cast; 16s CD; .7A each, bonus for separation
effect: Consumes both; no pulling through obstacles
presentation: Link brightens then snaps. Rewards keeping two dangerous foes separated; close together or break LOS to reduce result. Restarts setup instead of extending it indefinitely.

effect: No CC
presentation: Pale expanding audible ring. Predict pack movement; leave the ring in PvP. Echo can preserve its location for Aftervoice.

effect: Consume echo, 25% slow 2s
presentation: Ghost collapses with thin ripple. Punishes returning to a lane; visible echo warns enemies. Gives basics a location-setting role.

effect: Travel along validated path, consume echo; no teleport through walls
presentation: Dotted path before movement. Correct a PvE positioning mistake; enemy can pressure destination. Competes with Aftervoice's use of history.

effect: Next committed enemy skill has a visible warning mark; eventual brief cast delay, no basic lockout
presentation: Small pulsing ear glyph. Future caster pressure, not blanket silence. Opponent can use basics or wait. Supports landing Second Sound.

skill: Long Note - hold a threatened lane
effect: Stationary caster; lost LOS stops damage
presentation: Thin line charges from near to far. Hits aligned packs; obvious side-step/flank counterplay. Echo provides alternative lane origin at cost of consuming it.

skill: Keep the Last - decide what to retain
effect: Extend one echo by 4s, cannot extend it again
presentation: Ring around retained ghost fades in segments. Enables deliberate encounter pacing; opponents see the saved setup. No cooldown reset or repeated ultimate loop.

skill: Set Kiln - claim a work site
effect: Place destructible 8s kiln; replacing loses fuel
presentation: Small low stone bowl with legible perimeter. PvE staging; enemy can destroy or leave it. All other skills still have weaker off-site forms.

effect: Brief burn, strongest refresh only
presentation: Low sparks not opaque flame. Deals with melee packs; step out before burst. Uses one fuel for reach rather than mandatory damage amplification.

effect: Spend fuel for shield duration, not shield stacking
presentation: Warm faceted shoulder plate. Respond to dangerous hits; wait it out or remove shield. Competes with using fuel offensively.

effect: Slow burning strip for 3s
presentation: Low red coals show exact lane. Lure PvE pack, walk around in PvP. Relies on kiln position rather than instant targeted denial.

effect: Consume kiln for limited heal, proportional unspent fuel
presentation: Coals collapse into hands. Recover between pressures; enemy can deny by breaking kiln. Sacrifices offense/position for recovery.

effect: Push over time; kiln adds 1m reach, not stun
presentation: Cloth bellows and transparent heat lines. Peels pack from site; evade narrow telegraph. Creates time to Stoke without permanent control.

effect: Gain Heat for 4s, incoming +15%
presentation: Orange chest glow and small bolt. Reliable setup; pressure the exposed caster. Basic hit can safely vent instead of pursuing combo.

skill: Ashfall Debt - risk a delayed area
effect: Heat expands radius but remains until vented
presentation: Sparse descending ash telegraph. Good on predictable packs; leave marked area in PvP. Not a guaranteed targeted burst.

effect: Consume Heat; no damage
presentation: Chest glow snaps to dull gray shell. Survive retaliation; opponent has already forced lost offensive utility. Shields refresh, do not add.

effect: With Heat, trail lasts longer; no i-frames
presentation: Short ember footprint trail. Escape melee and punish pursuit; route around. Does not clear exposure, unlike Cold Palm.

effect: Consume Heat for single burst bonus bounded by damage received while exposed
presentation: Glowing palm closes visibly. Against strong PvE enemy; break LOS or withhold hits to deny bonus. Never encourages taking lethal damage.

effect: Short accuracy debuff on monsters; future PvP damage-output reduction, Heat extends duration
presentation: Thin gray gust with clear edges. Mitigates a dangerous pack; flank to avoid. Alternative to Reckon, not another explosion.

effect: No CC
presentation: Bow silhouette and narrow tracer. Pick rear PvE target; sidestep windup in PvP. Uses lane, not homing distance damage.

effect: No duplicate arrows on lone target
presentation: Clearly separate low arc trails. Controlled pack pull; cover denies individual arrows. Complements single-target basics.

effect: Erase lane; collision travel
presentation: Broken green line and low hop. Create spacing; opponent can pursue immediately, no immunity. Trade aim for safety.

effect: 30% slow 2.5s only if beyond 4m
presentation: Arrow with visible vine tether. Helps strong enemies' approach; closing distance denies control. No root chain.

effect: Visible snare line triggers once, short slow
presentation: Reed stakes and thin cord. Route PvE pack; opponents can detour or consume it deliberately. Enhances spatial play instead of stealth ambush.

skill: Narrow Horizon - finish a held shot
effect: Pierces first two bodies, no control
presentation: Lane brightens progressively. Reward careful alignment; interrupt or step aside. Cannot maintain aim while escaping with Cut the Reed.

effect: Place 7s seed, oldest replaced at cap two
presentation: Small bright sapling, outlined root radius. PvE setup; leave or destroy in PvP. Basics ripen it, skills do not auto-fill it.

effect: Ripe growth adds brief slow; consume ripeness
presentation: Low outward thorn spokes. Hits packs without hiding them; windup and growth location warn enemies. Keeps plant for later basic cultivation.

effect: Relocate plant along validated ground, preserve ripeness
presentation: Visible root trail, never instant unseen trap. Adapt to a moving PvE pack; enemy sees destination. Competes with staying to ripen; no player teleport.

effect: Consume ripeness for stronger bounded healing; damage does not grant invulnerability
presentation: Two translucent small leaves, no opaque dome. Recovery in group combat; force player out of area to stop ticks. Costs offensive harvest.

effect: 3s 35% slow corridor; consumes both ripeness states
presentation: Roots emerge along exact boundary. Herds packs; can walk around endpoints. Unlike Knotbinder links, endpoints are fixed destructible world objects.

effect: Consume plant for pulse; ripe variant weakens enemy damage briefly
presentation: Branches fold inward then snap outward. Strong encounter conclusion; leave ring during cast. Ends investment instead of starting an infinite zone cycle.
